entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: An elvish champion who learns that Mirrodin is hollow and fights her way down to its secret interior.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: An artificer who waits for Glissa inside Mirrodin, studies blinkmoths, and builds the Darksteel Eye.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A metallic world with a secret hollow interior.

entities.name: Chunth
entities.description: The Tel-Jilad troll elder who entrusts Glissa with the secret that the world is hollow before his death at the hands of a traitor.

entities.name: Lumengrid
entities.description: The great vedalken capital through which Glissa fights.

entities.name: Pool of Knowledge
entities.description: The Synod's sacred chamber, which contains a lacuna leading to Mirrodin's interior.

entities.name: The Synod
entities.description: The vedalken group whose sacred chamber contains the lacuna; its members pursue Glissa.

entities.name: Mycosynth
entities.description: Huge fungus-like metal towers inside Mirrodin that reach up toward an inner sun of pure mana.

entities.name: Darksteel Eye
entities.description: A device Memnarch is building that will make his omniscience over Mirrodin complete.

events.summary: Chunth entrusts Glissa with the secret that the world is hollow before a traitor kills him.
events.quote: This is the secret that Chunth , the Tel-Jilad troll elder, entrusts to Glissa before his death at the hands of a traitor.

events.summary: Glissa fights through Lumengrid and down into the Pool of Knowledge, whose lacuna leads to Mirrodin's interior.
events.quote: Glissa fights her way through the great vedalken capital of Lumengrid , down into the Pool of Knowledge .

events.summary: Fleeing her vedalken pursuers, Glissa discovers that Memnarch is real and waits for her.
events.quote: Memnarch is real, and he patiently waits for the elvish champion to find him.

relations.note: Entrusts her with a secret before dying.
relations.quote: This is the secret that Chunth , the Tel-Jilad troll elder, entrusts to Glissa
As Glissa flees from her vedalken pursuers

relations.note: He has begun to build it.
relations.quote: he studies the blinkmoths and has begun to build a monument to his greatness as an artificer

relations.note: Glissa goes down into the Pool of Knowledge from Lumengrid.
relations.quote: down into the Pool of Knowledge
